g.text: No UPDATE, no DELETE. A wrong entry is corrected
by posting a reversing movement pointing back at
A warehouse's only real asset is being able to
state what it held on the day of an audit; a
mutable ledger cannot answer that at all.
Quantity is ALWAYS POSITIVE - meaning is the
Stock is not "300 m of 6in pipe" but
"120 m of heat A-4471 + 180 m of heat A-4472".
A TPI signing a pressure-containing weld must
name the heat and produce its certificate.
balance() is COMPUTED LIVE, never stored. A cached
balance beside an append-only ledger is two sources
of truth that drift, and when they disagree nobody
The engineer confirms the spec; the PM confirms the
budget. Either can refuse for a reason the other
commercial" is a real state a buyer sits in for days.
